formula.input: For each valid word, h is the existing contextual 1024-vector; roles still feed original key encoders. Zero-norm h -> diagnostic undefined, report count; no chosen replacement.
formula.distance: d_ij=1-<h_i,h_j>/(||h_i|| ||h_j||), over all unordered valid i<j, T>=2.
formula.kernel_Q: KQ_ij=|psi_i^* psi_j|^2 from the existing Q head word states, no relation query.
formula.kernel_D_sameQ: KD_ij=sum_a |psi_ia|^2 |psi_ja|^2, same Q states dephased only for the diagnostic.
formula.kernel_G: KG_ij=exp(-||s*key_G(h_i,roles_i)-s*key_G(h_j,roles_j)||^2), exact frozen anisotropic Gaussian key projection/scale from strongest declared Gcov checkpoint.
formula.kernel_real16: v_i=(Re psi_i,Im psi_i); K16_ij=(v_i dot v_j)^2+(v_i dot J v_j)^2, J=[0,-I;I,0]. Must match KQ, not a separately trained control.
formula.association: A(K,d)=sum_{i<j} K_ij*d_ij / sum_{i<j} K_ij - mean_{i<j}(d_ij). Zero kernel mass -> undefined/report, no epsilon added.
formula.one_primary_statistic: S=A(KQ,d)-A(KG,d). Higher S means Q similar-state pairs span more contextual-input distance than G similar-key pairs.
formula.reference: Raw contextual cosine distance is a proxy, not a semantic truth, task-relevance certificate or graph. No role/length subset of pairs.

diagnostic_gate.primary: Ordinary pooled AUC on all Qdistinct/Gcov discordants, positive=Gcov correct only, higher S positive; ties count 1/2.
diagnostic_gate.sample_minimum: At least100 discordants and at least30 in each direction. Report all missing/undefined counts. Any missing statistic in primary population stops this exact prediction; no dropping cases.
diagnostic_gate.cutoff: AUC(S)>=0.55 and AUC(S)-max(AUC(each of the three prespecified scalar/dephased controls))>=0.02.
diagnostic_gate.secondary: Report all80 gold-class x fixed length<=35/>35 strata counts and within-stratum concordance, including empty/unpaired strata. No subgroup overrides pooled gate.
diagnostic_gate.on_pass: Exploratory association only. Does not reopen gen98, admit training, establish cause, newT, L3 or L4-T.
